summary: In this tutorial, you will learn how to customize the JChemPaint software, which is used for editing chemical structures. The tutorial covers changing the background color of the panel, setting the user interface language, and adding templates. To open the JChemPaint window, you need to run the Java application from the terminal on Ubuntu Linux OS. You can change the background color by going to the "Edit" menu, selecting "Preferences," then choosing "Background Color." For other preferences, select "Other Preferences" and change the "Look and Feel" to Nimbus for a different appearance. Changing the user interface language involves selecting "American English" or another language from the "User Interface Language" dropdown. Templates can be added through the "Templates" menu or the side toolbar. The tutorial also shows how to view various structure templates available in the software.
